title: Book Three · Chapter 176: Mum's Saturday Afternoon
story:
On the last Saturday of September, Mum closes her work book before lunch.

She has moved one customer's visit to the morning. Her afternoon is for a sewing class with a local dressmaker.

“Four Saturdays,” she tells Ronan. “Two until four.”

He looks at the cloth in her green and grey bag.

“For a customer?”

“For me. And for practice.”

She shows him a narrow pattern piece. She wants to learn a different way to shape the side of a jacket.

The four classes cost eight yuan altogether. Mum has kept that amount in her own work money box. She takes it out and puts it in her purse.

Ronan walks with her to the class room. It is above a small clothes shop. Several women are already putting cloth on the tables.

The dressmaker meets Mum at the door. Mum pays the eight yuan and writes her own name beside the four dates.

Ronan gives her the bag. She takes out her cloth and starts talking to the woman at the next table.

“I will see you at home,” she says.

He smiles and leaves her with the new group.

At home, Dad is resting near the open window before he returns to work. Ronan tells him about the pattern.

“A jacket for herself?”

“Yes.”

Dad nods. “She showed me that shape a few weeks ago.”

Ronan opens his own book while Dad finishes his tea. Later, he makes room near the window for Mum's cloth.

She comes home after four. The first pattern has pencil marks along its side. She lays it beside an old piece and studies both.

“Different?” Ronan asks.

“A little. Enough to change the sleeve.”

She shows him with two fingers, then takes the cloth to her chair.

At the end of September, Mum and Dad check the household book again. Dad puts twelve yuan and Mum eight into the study envelope.

Their one hundred and twenty becomes one hundred and forty. Ronan's seventy-two and twenty and a half remain separate. The three amounts now total two hundred and thirty-two and a half.

Mum keeps her class pattern beside her own work book. The study envelope goes back to its place with the household book.

Before dinner, she puts the cloth against her shoulder to check the shape. Dad comes in from work and tilts his head to look.

“A new coat?”

“A jacket,” she says. “You will see the difference.”

Ronan laughs and brings the plates to the table while Mum holds the unfinished side in place.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pattern＝服装纸样；dressmaker＝做衣服的师傅；shape＝做出某种形状；tilt＝倾斜、歪一点。

## 理解问题

1. Mum四次课的时间与总费用怎样？从哪部分钱付，是否减了学习信封？
2. 九月底父母实际新存后，他们持有和三份合计各是多少？

## 读句子

**Her afternoon is for a sewing class with a local dressmaker.**

拆开看：Her afternoon / is for a sewing class / with a local dressmaker.

她这天下午／安排给了一节缝纫课／跟本地做衣服的师傅学习。
